column1: # Ember chip logical pinout — SOURCE OF TRUTH.
# Consumed by scripts/gds/make_pad_ring.py (bit-blasts width rows into physical
# pads and plans the ring) and documented in docs/chip_pinout.md.
#   dir      : in | out | inout (chip core perspective)
#   width    : bus width; a row expands to `width` one-bit pads
#   side     : N | S | E | W (ring row the pads sit on)
#   group    : functional block name (used for ordering + docs)
# Power/ground and corner pads are NOT listed here: make_pad_ring.py inserts
# sky130_fd_io power/ground pads to balance the ring and 4 corner_bus_overlay
# Signal pads: 373 total (N 76 / S 91 / E 104 / W 102).
# Die is pad-limited; see docs/chip_pinout.md for the budget.
